patch_selection: First nonempty constructed patch in the original common-Degree trace, including root-pruned/capped patches; never use gain, bound tightness, labels or program outcome
pair_selection: SHA-first adjacent pairs, then SHA-first nonadjacent pairs on edge shortfall; every quota shortfall remains
query_bank: Union of four core SHA pairs and ALL original strict TRAIN requirement pairs whose actions both remain in Rprime; deduplicate unordered pairs, preserve both stratum flags
added_stratum_scope: Conditioned on already-frozen full strict certification and patch membership, not natural incidence; no program/new-local-outcome filtering
duplicate_deployment_asts: Retain assigned identities; they are not independent program draws
local_scope: Forced include values in the saved restricted patch with saved outside incumbent fixed; outside constant weight cancels
full_scope: Existing original full-residual labels at original permanent F/X, separately evaluated on patch scores; no new full-label query
interpretation: Ranking agreement is neither branch-pivot efficiency certification nor complete-schedule improvement
